summary: Verified Phase 27 AI Customisation restore + Pari/Help collision fix end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (public mode default, admin PATCH auth+validation+persistence-reachable, public+admin question list with 13 seeded rows, admin POST→DELETE round-trip w/cleanup, validation errors). Frontend: dashboard help bubble now at bottom-LEFT (x=32) with `left-5 sm:left-8`; Pari bubble stays bottom-right; landing bubble still bottom-right (x=1797). Admin panel AI Customisation tab renders all 3 mode buttons (Off marked active via purple border/bg), 13-row questions table, working Add-question modal with 4 type options, and the options editor correctly hides for text/number types. FAQs tab still loads without regression.

minor.issue: app_settings table exists in Supabase but with an older schema — missing `value_json` column. PostgREST returns PGRST204 which the endpoint bubbles up as HTTP 400 (with body 'Failed to persist mode: ...value_json column...'). The graceful GET default 'off' still works fine, but PATCH cannot actually persist a mode until 0034_app_settings.sql is applied (or the existing table is amended). Not a regression; matches the review-request expectation that persistence would fail until migration.

action_items: Apply /app/scripts/migrations/0034_app_settings.sql (or amend the existing `app_settings` table to include a `value_json JSONB` column + `updated_at` + UNIQUE(key) constraint) so admin can persist AI-mode changes. Until then, /admin/app-settings/ai-customization PATCH will keep returning 400 with a PGRST204 detail. GET remains gracefully 'off'.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.jsx is now 1728 lines (was 1140 last iteration) — well past the 700-line split threshold. Extract CustomizationTab + CustomizationEditModal into /app/frontend/src/components/admin/CustomizationTab.jsx alongside the existing FaqsTab candidate.
wave_endpoints.py is 2373 lines — still growing. Route groups (AI Customisation, FAQs, Portfolio, Doubts, etc.) should be split into resource-specific routers.

PATCH persistence-error mapping in admin_set_ai_customization_mode() re-raises with the original Supabase status code — a PGRST schema error surfaces as HTTP 400 which reads like a validation failure. Consider forcing 503 (or 500) for any downstream PostgREST failure so the FE can render an infra-vs-user-input distinction.
